cases.mechanism: ThinkParser.parse keeps the text after the last '</think>'. extract_boxed_answer is non-strict, so when there is no '\boxed{' (rfind == -1) it returns the whole post-think text unchanged. correct_label_reward_func uppercases it and finds no exact label. The fallback `if "ENTAIL" in parsed: parsed = "ENTAILMENT"` then matches the word inside the rejecting sentence, giving 1.0.
cases.why_incorrect: There is no \boxed{} answer, so the verifier finds nothing to extract. The prose also explicitly rejects entailment, which is the gold label, so the response does not answer ENTAILMENT.
